headline: Nvidia Loses $611 Billion in Market Value Over Six-Day Slump
summary: Nvidia's shares fell further, bringing total market capitalization losses to $611 billion over six trading days. Only 23 companies globally have an overall market capitalization higher than that amount.
why: Nvidia is the dominant supplier of AI accelerator chips and one of the largest companies by market capitalization. Sharp pullbacks in its valuation heavily affect tech sector performance and major equity benchmarks.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Nvidia lost $611 billion in market value over a six-trading-day decline.
